summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, providing voluntary disclosure regarding logistics for its annual regular cash dividend of US$0.13125 per ordinary share or US$1.05 per ADS, declared on May 13, 2026. The dividend is payable in U.S. dollars to holders of record as of June 11, 2026. The filing details procedures for ordinary shareholders and ADS holders, including temporary suspension of conversion between ADSs and ordinary shares from June 9 to June 11, 2026. This is a routine dividend distribution announcement with no special-situation event.
